3442115.sourceDescription: Cherish the memory of a loved one this Christmas with our personalized memorial bauble. t0xgws30.sourceDescription: Following in the footsteps of our popular Snowy Scots Pine tree, this 5ft fibre optic tree is the ideal festive antidote to dull evenings. Coming with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches, mini acrylic flowers and pre-attached pine cones, it really is a stunning 5ft fibre optic tree that you'll be eager to display in your home. An affordable option for anyone looking to light up their home with a sprinkling of Yuletide charm, the 5ft Snowy Frosted Pine fibre optic tree is the ultimate choice for any Xmas lover! e2y62ajd.sourceDescription: This lovely and lifelike artificial slim Christmas tree with distinctive tips will become the focal point of your holiday decorations. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation.
